tjalda.title: Tjalda.is – Úthlíð, Biskupstungu (2026 rates, season & services)

ferdalag-winter.title: Ferdalag.is (Icelandic Tourist Board) – Camper winter service

intro.value: A family campsite on the hillside below Réttin restaurant in Biskupstungur, on the Golden Circle about 10 km from Geysir and 20 km from Gullfoss. Úthlíð also has holiday cottages, a 9-hole golf course, horse rental, a small shop and a swimming pool with hot tubs.

address.note: tjalda.is gives postcode 870, ferdalag.is 806 Selfoss and the operator's site 801 Selfoss.

winter.value: Open all year (own site and tjalda.is; also on ferdalag.is's camper winter service list). In winter, motorhomes and campervans park in the area around Réttin restaurant and use the toilets in the swimming-pool building.

applies_to.value: 2026 rates (tjalda.is; the operator's page gives the same amounts without a year)

items.label: Lodging tax per unit per night

electricity.value: Yes (1,000 ISK per night). Number of hook-ups and winter hook-ups: Unconfirmed.

kitchen.value: Indoor area for eating and washing up is included in the price; the operator's page lists cooking facilities as outdoor only ('Já útiaðstaða'). No indoor kitchen is listed.

showers.value: Yes, included in the price (as are the hot tubs)

toilets.value: Yes (flush toilets); in winter the toilets in the swimming-pool building are used

dump_station.value: Yes – sludge disposal for motorhomes ('Seyrulosun fyrir húsbíla: já') and a drinking-water hose, per the operator's page. Exact location and winter availability: ask on arrival.

laundry.value: Washing machine and tumble dryer, for an extra fee (amount not published)

camping_card.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

practical.value: Families only: the age limit is 25 unless travelling with adults.
Drop-in; groups must book in advance by phone (699 5500).
Quiet from 23:00; personal sound systems are discouraged.
